page.content:

page.overview:
Who is Charlie Cargo?

Charlie is seen in the ending credits of the film at Sarge's SUV Boot Camp, along with T.J. Hummer, Frank "Pinky" Pinkerton and Murphy. They are all given an off-road task by Sarge.
